files.description: Hospital admissions (260 rows): admission_id (whole number), age (years, whole number; about 5% empty), ward (cardiology, oncology, maternity, orthopedics or neurology; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), stay_days (whole number; about 3% empty), charge (two decimals; about 5% empty).

task_text: A missing charge means that nothing was billed, i.e. 0. Taking that into account, compute the average charge per ward (ward names in lower case without extra spaces), rounded to two decimals. `result` should be a Series indexed by ward.
intended_computation: Treat the 12 missing charges as 0, clean ward (5 wards) and return the mean charge per ward over all its admissions, rounded to 2 decimals.

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.x the in-place fill on the selected column is lost, so missing charges are skipped instead of counted as 0

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
